entries.name: Horse (animated), Quaternius 2021
entries.author: Quaternius
entries.notes: Single GLB downloaded from https://static.poly.pizza/d37dbc87-ca61-4b2c-a2da-d2f0c4240bef.glb (1108124 bytes); sha256 is of that file (no archive). Licence evidence, checked 2026-09-29: the Poly Pizza page states "Public Domain (CC0)" and links creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/; the 2021 pack page https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html states "License CC0". Quaternius's licence page (quaternius.com/license.html) now shows the "Quaternius Asset License (QAL) v1.0", last updated 8/28/2026, which forbids redistributing "the Assets themselves ... as a standalone asset" and says "the version in effect at the time you obtained the Assets governs your use of them". Re-checked 2026-10-01: the pack page still states "License: CC0" and links the CC0 1.0 deed, and the Poly Pizza page still states "Public Domain (CC0)"; the QAL v1.0 page says nothing about assets earlier released under CC0, and the CC0 1.0 waiver is irrevocable. Owner decision (2026-10-01): keep the model, recorded as CC0-1.0; it was obtained as CC0 and is used inside a game, not redistributed standalone. The folder's License.txt records this evidence. Used for the king's horse.
